Order Order

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with Nimapara P.S. Case No.28 of 2023 registered under Sections 376(2)(n)/506 of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.79 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Judge, Puri.
3. Learned counsel for the State submits that, in this case, the charge has already been framed.
The petitioner is a 65 years old man and the victim is 16 years of age and the allegations are serious.
4. Therefore, since the charge has already been framed, I am not inclined to entertain this application at this stage.
However, the petitioner is granted liberty to renew his prayer for bail after examination of the victim and the material witnesses.
It is expected that // 2 // the learned trial Court would see to it that the victim and eye witnesses are preferentially examined before the formal witnesses.
The petitioner may renew his bail plea after expiry of six months, if the trial is not proceeded at the expected pace.
5. With this observation, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge amit Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Prabhakar Das vs State Of Odisha & Another ....
